definition: The line between two panes, which you can pull to make a pane wider or narrower. In focus, the arrow keys nudge it and shift strides it; Home or a double click restores its width, and Enter folds a pane that folds.
basis: Our wording of the pane margin, which docs/workbench.md describes: it is a real separator, whose keys are "arrows nudge, shift-arrows stride", and a "double-click restores the shipped width". Only a pane that is chrome folds, because "a Fault Corpus with the fault list folded away is not a decluttered Fault Corpus".
